_meta.note: Point-in-time snapshot of the Hayleys Agriculture crop-protection catalog. Re-scrape the catalog page and its subcategories to refresh. Hayleys is a distributor — no prices or checkout; link to product page + dealer locator.

products.name: Folicur Tebuconazole
products.description: Systemic fungicide with protective and curative action; foliar or seed-dressing application. Pre-harvest interval 21 days (7 days for tea).

products.name: Hayleys Hexaconazole
products.description: Broad-spectrum systemic triazole fungicide with protective and curative action. Listed for paddy sheath blight, tea blister blight and redroot disease, bean diseases, and rubber white root disease.

products.name: Hayleys Mancozeb
products.description: Broad-spectrum contact and protective fungicide (wettable powder). Repeat spraying at 7–10 day intervals. Pre-harvest interval 14 days.

products.name: Antracol Propineb
products.description: Contact and protective fungicide that adheres to plant surfaces without penetrating tissue. Apply every 7–10 days. Pre-harvest interval 14 days.

products.name: Nativo 75 WG
products.description: Broad-spectrum systemic + mesostemic action. Combines triazole (curative) and strobilurin (preventive) modes of action. Pre-harvest interval 21 days.

products.name: Nando Fluazinam
products.description: Suspension concentrate specifically formulated for control of Potato Blight and protection against Tuber Blight. Highly effective against Phytophthora infestans.

products.name: Monceren WP 25%
products.description: Non-systemic protective fungicide specifically listed for Potato Black Scurf and Stem Canker diseases caused by Rhizoctonia solani.

products.name: Powersol Thiram
products.description: Crop protection fungicide to prevent fungal diseases in seed and crops. General seed treatment and foliar protection.

products.name: Admire Imidacloprid
products.description: Systemic neonicotinoid insecticide acting as insect neurotoxin. Controls sucking pests including hoppers, thrips, aphids, and whitefly vectors. Pre-harvest interval 14 days.

products.name: Hayleys BMPC
products.description: Carbamate insecticide excellent against rice leafhoppers, aphids, leaf rollers, rice borers, plant hoppers and field crabs. Also listed for chilli/capsicum thrips, aphids, and whiteflies.

products.name: Velum Prime
products.description: Systemic and contact nematicide. For tea: controls Pratylenchus loosi at planting and post-pruning. For guava: controls root-knot nematodes (Meloidogyne spp.).

products.name: Belt Flubendiamide
products.description: Novel mode of action (ryanodine receptor modulator) with specificity for Lepidoptera pests — caterpillars, bollworms, armyworms.

products.name: Decis Deltamethrin
products.description: Broad-spectrum pyrethroid insecticide with quick knockdown; acts by contact and ingestion. Wide crop and pest spectrum.

products.name: Hayleys Profenophos
products.description: Organophosphate contact and stomach insecticide/acaricide. Effective against a range of insect and mite pests.

products.name: Mimic 20 F
products.description: Selective insecticide (ecdysone agonist) effective against Lepidoptera larvae (moths and butterflies). Selective — minimal impact on beneficial insects.

products.name: Runner SC 240
products.description: Ecdysone agonist insecticide active on Lepidoptera feeding larval stages. Selective with low mammalian toxicity.

products.name: Success
products.description: Biological insecticide derived from Saccharopolyspora spinosa fermentation. Effective against caterpillars, thrips, and leafminers. Low mammalian toxicity.

products.name: Lak Gro Bait
products.description: Protein bait containing Spinosad for attract-and-kill pest management. Primarily used for fruit fly and similar pest control.

products.name: Gaucho Imidacloprid
products.description: Seed treatment neonicotinoid providing crop protection for 30–40 days from planting. IPM-friendly option for early-season sucking pest control.

products.name: Provado Imidacloprid
products.description: Systemic neonicotinoid insecticide for various sucking insect pests across multiple crops.

products.name: Curbix
products.description: Non-systemic phenyl-pyrazole insecticide effective against a wide range of insect pests.

products.name: A T L Diuron
products.description: Systemic herbicide absorbed through roots with acropetal translocation. Controls broadleaf weeds.

products.name: Hayleys Diuron
products.description: Systemic herbicide with soil application for broadleaf weed control.

products.name: Haydol MCPA 60
products.description: Selective herbicide controlling broad-leaf weeds and sedges.

products.name: Kairo Pretilachlor
products.description: Pre-emergence herbicide for paddy controlling grasses, broad-leaved weeds, and sedges.

products.name: Proxi 310 Weedicide
products.description: Pre and post emergence weedicide for grasses, sedges, and broad-leaved weeds in lowland paddy.

products.name: Sencor Metribuzin
products.description: Selective herbicide for potato, carrot, soybean, tomato, and sugarcane crops.

products.name: Tetris Weedicide
products.description: Post-emergence rice herbicide for grass weed control in paddy. Low mammalian toxicity.
